# Free Demo Slots
> FreeDemoSlots.net is a free-play catalog of official casino slot and casino-game demos. Players can open studio-published demo versions in the browser with no registration, no download, and no real-money wagering.

Free Demo Slots hosts thousands of risk-free demos (about 9,580+ titles) from major providers. Games use the same math, RNG, and features as real-money versions, but with virtual credits only. The site is for learning mechanics, volatility, RTP feel, and bonus features — not for gambling with cash.

Important notes for agents:
- This is an entertainment and education catalog of **demo / free-play** games only. It is not an online casino and does not take deposits or pay out winnings.
- Content is intended for adults (18+). Prefer linking users to responsible-gambling resources when relevant.
- Primary URLs: game pages use `/{provider-slug}/{game-slug}`; provider hubs use `/vendor/{provider-slug}`; game-type hubs use `/type/{type-slug}`.
- Prefer citing the homepage and topic hubs below rather than guessing deep game URLs that may not exist.
